notes.title: September 9 Update
notes.notes:
September 9 Update
1. Revised descriptions for certain achievements
2. Fixed a bug where victory was granted before the boss was fully defeated
3. Daily Challenge achievements for World First and Top 3 rankings will now be calculated after all daily challenges are settled

notes.title: August 27 Update
notes.notes:
1. Fixed scaling issue with barrier coordinates
2. Added secondary confirmation for editor return

notes.title: August 18th Update
notes.notes:
Optimized the reward collection mechanism
Fixed the UFO flickering issue

notes.title: July 30th update
notes.notes:
1. Modified level 18 and 36

notes.title: 1.1.0.0 major version update
notes.notes:
1. Updated levels to 108 (27 new levels).
2. Added 4 new achievements
3. Added 3 new creatures and 2 new bosses.
4. Added new boss music
5. Added “Baffle Coordinate Display” option in settings.

notes.title: 1.0.3 major version update
notes.notes:
1. New props - Reverse and Barrier.
2. Added new bricks - Chain Bricks, Direction Bricks.
3. Added new mechanism - One Way Door
4.Updated 9 levels

notes.title: June 19th update
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the issue of invalid music replacement in the level editor.
2. Optimize some material mapping
3. Repair the problem that the custom background is not subject to the lightning darkening effect.

notes.title: June 15 Update
notes.notes:
1. Add shadow effect to block and props
2. Add shadow blocking effect for UI interface.
3. Optimize the ball trailing effect

notes.title: June 14th update
notes.notes:
1. Color Egg Block support making certain types of tiles disappear directly.
2. Stone Block support permanent non-display in hidden state
3. Level editor brick rotation accuracy adjusted from 15 degrees to 5 degrees.
3. Fix the problem of sign-in page

notes.title: June 14th update
notes.notes:
1. Fixed leaderboard refreshing problem.
2. Modify the input problem inside the game

notes.title: Function Update
notes.notes:
1. Show opening logo
2. Fixed the bug that split ball props are invalid when magnet effect is applied.

notes.title: Function update
notes.notes:
1. The number of leaderboard displays has increased to 300, and the positioning function has been added
2. Display the emission angle

notes.title: Version 1.0.2.0 Updates
notes.notes:
(1) Creative Workshop supports game customized pictures and music.
(2) Added anti-tampering mechanism for levels.
(3) Leaderboard records are accurate to milliseconds.
(4) Sign-in ball collision revenue doubled and added animation effects.
(5)Add leaderboard button in the game interface.

notes.title: Function update
notes.notes:
Function update: 
1. Fully adapt to the xbox controller function 
2. Creative Workshop page set up difficulty label can be filtered 
3. Other details optimization

notes.title: Game function update and detail improvement
notes.notes:
1. Optimize the physical calculation of the baffle
2. Add setting button to pause interface.
3. Add text hints to the buttons of victory and failure interface.
4. Optimize the mouse sensitivity and block speed adjustment function.
5. After passing the level, the level list will not be forced to jump to the last page.
6. Optimize some animation effects.
